answer_1.quote: The primary objective of FUSECHAT is to integrate multiple chat LLMs into a more powerful model. Consequently, our experiments primarily focus on alignment training data, such as ShareGPT, and chat model evaluation benchmarks like AlpacaEval 2.0 and MT-Bench.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates dialogue responses to instructions in multi-turn conversations, evaluated on instruction-following and conversational abilities.

answer_2.quote: We assess the performance of FUSECHAT-7B on two representative benchmarks to evaluate its ability to follow instructions and engage in conversations effectively. The first benchmark, AlpacaEval 2.0 , comprises 805 instructions across five test subsets. It compares the Win Rate and Length-Controlled Win Rate (LC Win Rate)  of a model against GPT-4.

answer_3.quote: We employ the default settings and utilize GPT-4 (GPT-4-1106-Preview) to evaluate the quality of generated responses.
